ja511:1.1: Kiṃchando kimadhippāyo eko sammasi ghammani, kiṃ patthayāno kiṃ esaṃ kena atthena brāhmaṇā 'ti.
ja511:2.1: Yathā mahā vāridharo kumbho supariṇāmavā tathūpamaṃ ambapakkam vaṇṇagandharasuttamaṃ.
ja511:3.1: Taṃ vuyhamānaṃ sotena disvān' amalamajjhime pāṇīhi naṃ gahetvāna agyāyatanam āhariṃ.
ja511:4.1: Tato kadalipattesu nikkhipitvā sayaṃ ahaṃ satthena naṃ vikappetvā khuppipāsaṃ ahāsi me.
ja511:5.1: So 'haṃ apetadaratho vyantibhūto dukhakkhamo assādaṃ nādhigacchāmi phalesv-aññesu kesuci.
ja511:6.1: Sosetvā nūna maraṇaṃ taṃ mamaṃ āvahissati ambaṃ y' assa phalaṃ sāduṃ [yam uddhariṃ] vuyhamānaṃ [udadhismā] mahaṇṇave.
ja511:7.1: Akkhātan te mayā sabbaṃ yasmā upavasām' aham, rammaṃ pati nisinno 'smi, puthulomāyutā puthū.
ja511:8.1: Tvañ ca kho me va akkhāhi attānam apalāyini, kā vā tvam asi kalyāni, kissa vā tvaṃ sumajjhime.
ja511:9.1: Ruppapaṭṭapalimaṭṭhīva vyagghīva girisānujā yā santi nariyo devesu devānaṃ paricārikā
ja511:10.1: Yā ca manussalokasmiṃ rūpen' anvāgatitthiyo -- rūpe te sadisī n' atthi devesu gandhabbamanussaloke, puṭṭhāsi me, cārupubbaṅgi brūhi, akkhāhi me nāmañ ca bandhave cā 'ti.
ja511:11.1: Yaṃ tvaṃ pati nisinno si rammaṃ brāhmaṇa Kosikiṃ sāhaṃ bhusālayā vutthā varavārivahoghasā.
ja511:12.1: Nānādumagaṇākiṇṇā bahukā girikandarā mam' eva pamukhā honti, abhisandanti pāvuso.
ja511:13.1: Atho bahū vanato 'dā nīlavārivahindharā bahukā nāgavittodā abhisandanti vārinā.
ja511:14.1: Tā ambajambulabujā nipā tālā c' udumbarā bahūni phalajātāni āvahanti abhiṇhaso.
ja511:15.1: Yaṃ kiñci ubhatotīre phalaṃ patati ambuhi asaṃsayaṃ taṃ sotassa phalaṃ hoti vasānugaṃ.
ja511:16.1: Etad aññāya medhavi puthupañña suṇohi me, mā rocaya-m-abhisaṅgam paṭisedha janādhipa.
ja511:17.1: Na vāhaṃ vaddhavaṃ maññe yaṃ tvaṃ raṭṭhābhivaddhana āceyyamāno rājisi maraṇaṃ abhikaṃkhasi.
ja511:18.1: Tassa jānanti pitaro gandhabbā ca sadevakā ye cāpi isayo loke saññatattā yasassino, asaṃsayan te jānanti vaddhabhūtā yasassino ti.
ja511:19.1: Evaṃ viditvā vidū sabbadhammaṃ viddhaṃsanaṃ cavanaṃ jīvitassa na cīyatī tassa narassa pāpam sace na ceteti vadhāya tassa.
ja511:20.1: Isipūgasamaññāte evaṃ lokyā viditā sati anariyaparisaṃbhāse pāpakammaṃ jigiṃsasi.
ja511:21.1: Sace ahaṃ marissāmi tīre te puthusussoṇi asaṃsayaṃ asiloko mayi pete āgamissati.
ja511:22.1: Tasmā hi pāpakaṃ kammaṃ rakkhass' eva sumajjhime mā taṃ sabbo jano pacchā pakatthāsi mayi mate ti.
ja511:23.1: Aññātam etaṃ avisayhasāhi, attānaṃ ambañ ca dadāmi te taṃ yo duccaje kāmaguṇe pahāya santiñ ca dhammañ ca adhiṭṭhito si.
ja511:24.1: Yo hitvā pubbasaṃyogaṃ pacchā saṃyojane ṭhito adhammañ c' eva carati pāpañ c' assa pavaḍḍhati.
ja511:25.1: Ehi, taṃ pāpayissāmi, kāmaṃ appossuko bhava, upanayāmi sītasmiṃ, viharāhi anussuko.
ja511:26.1: Taṃ puppharasamattehi vakkaṅgehi arindama, koñcā mayūrā diviyā koyaṭṭhimadhusāliyā kūjitā haṃsapūgehi kokil' ettha pabodhare.
ja511:27.1: Amb' ettha vippasūnaggā palālakhalasannibhā kosumbhasalaḷānīpā pakkatālavilambino ti.
ja511:28.1: Mālī tirīṭī kāyūrī aṅgadī candanussado rattiṃ tvaṃ paricāresi divā vedesi vedanaṃ.
ja511:29.1: Soḷas' itthisahassāni yā te 'mā paricārikā, evaṃ mahānubhāvo si abbhuto lomahaṃsano.
ja511:30.1: Kiṃ kammaṃ akarī pubbe pāpaṃ attadukhāvahaṃ yaṃ karitvā manussesu piṭṭhimaṃsāni khādasīti.
ja511:31.1: Ajjhenāni patiggayha kāmesu gathito ahaṃ, acariṃ dīgham addhānaṃ paresaṃ ahitāy' ahaṃ.
ja511:32.1: Yo piṭṭhimaṃsiyo hoti evaṃ ukkacca khādati yathāham ajja khādāmi piṭṭhimaṃsāni attano ti.
